answer: One effective anti-Sybil mechanism in an AI agent economy requires every agent to bond a fixed token stake into a shared pool monitored by a nebula of independent validators. Creating extra identities forces proportional additional bonds that a sparrow-like lightweight oracle can detect via behavioral clustering, enabling automated slashing of the entire stake cluster. This raises the attacker’s cost linearly with the number of fakes while honest agents in the grove incur only a one-time deposit.
